div.div:
أَحْرَدُ A camel (or a beast, L) having the disease, or fault, termed حَرَدٌ; (S, Mgh, L, Msb, K;) as also ↓ حَرِدٌ : (K:) fem. of the former حَرْدَآءُ. (S.) ―
-b2- A man oppressed by the weight of his coat of mail, and unable to stretch himself out in walking; (T, TA;) [and] so ↓ حَرِدٌ . (K.) ―
-b3- (tropical:) Niggardly; mean; sordid. (K, TA.) And أَحْرَدُ اليَدَيْنِ (assumed tropical:) Close-fisted, or niggardly. (T.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
